item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs skor las gsang chen rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i phyag mchod mu tig phreng ba lta ljon 'od 'phro
item.coloph: smras pa/ gsang chen grub thob rig 'dzin tshogs rnams la/ gsang mchod phyag mchod 'bul ba'i thabs zab mo/ gsang ba'i bshad byang mu tig phreng ba zhes/ gsang bdag dgyes pa'i rta ljon 'od 'phro 'di/ las ldan skyes bu 'gru btsun sku mched kyi/ zab gsang gsung gi dbyug tos bskul ba'i tshe/ gdung mchid bdag blo yid kyi rnga bo che/ dar dir mi sgrogs ka med sdod ma ster/ blo dman bdag gi skal ba yin bsam nas/ sngon byon rgyal ba'i bka' lung tha dag nas/ zab lam bshad byang nyung ngur bsdus pa po/ shel skyes tshe dbang bde snying pa des smras//
